translation: When the tombs are strewn around
Each soul will know what it has advanced, and what it has deferred

arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلۡكَرِيمِ
translation: O man! What deluded you concerning your Lord, the Most Generous
He Who created you, and formed you, and proportioned you

arabic: فِيٓ أَيِّ صُورَةٖ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
translation: In whatever shape He willed, He assembled you
The virtuous will be in bliss
While the wicked will be in Hell
They will enter it on the Day of Justice
And they will not be absent from it
But what will convey to you what the Day of Justice is

arabic: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا يَوۡمُ ٱلدِّينِ
translation: Then again, what will convey to you what the Day of Justice is

arabic: يَوۡمَ لَا تَمۡلِكُ نَفۡسٞ لِّنَفۡسٖ شَيۡـٔٗاۖ وَٱلۡأَمۡرُ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلَّهِ
translation: The Day when no soul will avail another soul anything; and the decision on that Day is God’s
